### Causal estimation with complex exposures

Multicausal and multivalued treatment effects in the potential outcomes
framework. Double-robust estimation, cross-fitting, and
influence-function-based inference when the treatment has more than two
levels and the nuisance models are learned by machine learning. See
[Software](../software.qmd) for the implementation.

### Machine learning and semiparametric efficiency

Using flexible learners inside semiparametric estimators without giving
up valid inference: targeted maximum likelihood, doubly robust learning,
and the variance estimation that makes them publishable.

### Applications in health and epidemiology

Causal questions in observational health data, where randomisation is
impossible and the assumptions have to be argued rather than verified.
